summary: Battery saver now, Performance mode, animation previews, Arabic notices

items.title: Battery saver now
items.text: One switch for the island and the PC: 60 Hz, the Balanced plan, Windows' animations and transparency off and Windows' Battery saver while unplugged. Switched off, everything comes back and the PC goes to Ultimate Performance. Settings › Island › Performance.

items.title: Performance mode
items.text: Switching the saver off launches the island: a revving gauge, shockwaves, sparks and speed streaks. Every battery notice now has its own animation too: saver on, stays on, charging, low battery, unplugged.

items.title: A shortcut for it (opt-in)
items.text: Ctrl+Alt+B switches the saver from anywhere, or from a touchpad gesture in Pady. Off unless you turn it on.

items.title: Preview animations
items.text: Settings › Island › Preview animations plays any of the island's animations on demand, from made-up data.

items.title: Right-to-left notices
items.text: Arabic, Hebrew and Persian messages read and scroll right to left, even when the sender's name is in Latin letters.

items.title: Fuller app icons
items.text: App logos that Windows hands over with wide empty margins are trimmed, so they fill their place.

summary: Songs turn to dust and reform, faster skips, better Now Playing

items.title: Song changes
items.text: The old song turns to soft dust and reforms as the new one, in the pill or in the Now Playing card. Settings › Island › Song change.

items.title: Faster skips
items.text: A skip shows on the island in about 0.4 s (it was up to 3 s).

items.title: Now Playing follows the right player
items.text: Apps that copy Spotify's song (like Spotifast) no longer confuse it, a paused VLC video stays on the island so play resumes it, and a player on mute doesn't take over.

items.title: The adhan
items.text: The companion always comes for the adhan, even right after the PC wakes up.
